lines.text: Ladder: climb and stop at the first rung that holds: YAGNI (skip speculative need, say so), reuse what the repo already has (/code-diet:reuse-first), stdlib, the platform, an installed dependency, one line, then the minimum that works. A bug fix is root cause: one guard where every caller routes. Never cut trust-boundary validation, data-loss handling, security, or accessibility. Mark a shortcut `debt: <ceiling>, <upgrade trigger>`.
